scene.placeText: a lamplit viewpoint terrace high above the old quarter of her world's river-mouth capital at dusk — walls of blue-and-white painted tiles, a tiled stone bench along the balustrade, terracotta rooftops tumbling down to the shining estuary and tall ships with white sails gliding home
scene.ownProp: a small round-bodied twelve-string guitar of pale wood with a scrolled head and a little brass watch-key at its tuners

scene.scene: she is the fado sorceress who sings the ships home, sitting sideways on the tiled bench to tune her twelve-string guitar with a little watch-key before the song, strands of pearls swaying over her wave-layered black silk
